ground.notes: ENV-U10 themed ground (tools/art/env_kit/ground_splat.py, ground-params.json): runtime = four /Engine/BasicShapes/Plane strips = tray top minus the frame (hole = frame outer - frameOverlapUU, outer = tray top - insetUU) at z, NoCollision, no shadow casting; material MI_EnvGround_<Map> (tools/art/env_kit/ue_import_env_ground.py) gets GroundStrip / SplatRect per strip (MID).

notes: Marmoreal - concept v1 (ENV-U8): palace colonnade along the far (-Y) edge = central Portal with steps + 2 ArcadeBay per side at scale 1.45 (bay 152 w x 189 h, portal 186 w x 218 h; the concept draws the colonnade ~2x the 130/150 proposal, 1.45 keeps it ~4 hero heights) spanning the frame width; Cypress (1.3 -> 143 h) at both colonnade ends (the concept's dark trees flanking the arcade); Urns flanking the portal steps; LanternPlinth lamps (1.2 -> 84 h) at the far corners and at W/E; Cherry trees (1.4 -> 252 h, the concept's trees tower over the colonnade) in the far halves of W/E with their narrow side towards the map (keeps the W tree's key-light shadow 27 uu off M07/M13); PlinthBall posts at the near corners. Near apron: stone + petals (decals later). 17 props, 5 warm lights (4 lanterns + portal glow); leaves 1 point for a cool moon fill. Conventions: board-actor space (origin = map centre, +X right on the K1 screen, +Y towards the K1 camera = near side, Z up, map plane ~0); props stand on the tray top z -3, pivot = base centre; yawDeg = UE actor yaw of the processed UM_FBX_v1 mesh (tools/art/env_kit/env_kit_build.py: local +X = FRONT = the Tripo 'front' reference view, Y = width, Z = up), so 90 turns the front to the K1 camera (+Y) with the width along X, 180 faces -X/west, 0 faces +X/east, -90 faces -Y/far; scale multiplies the processed mesh, whose size already equals its target (height; Hull/Cannon = length, Campfire/Rope = diameter = longest horizontal extent; e.g. Hull 300 x 64 x 256, Cannon 45 x 32 x 27). Tray (ENV-U10 / 'одна каменная подложка', T2): the ONE shared stone tray SM_TableBase_T2 of both map boards - halfX 780 x halfY 470 centred at (0, offsetY -45) (negative = towards the far side), flat top z -3, placed at scale 1 (no stretch; T1 SM_TableBase stays for the grid fixtures) = frame outer rectangle (|X| <= 469.667, |Y| <= 312.667) + apron n 202.33 / s 112.33 / w = e 310.33 (the apron follows the shared tray, art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-TABLE-BASE-001/20261001-tray-t2/reports/tray-t2-params.json); its rocky lip may rise to z +2 only within rimUU 20 of the tray edge (keep prop bases out of that band). The near band (Y > 312.667, |X| < 469.667, between the map and the camera) is kept empty; tall props only on the far side and in the far halves of W/E. Checked by tools/art/env_kit/layout_check.py: no prop box covers or comes within 4 px (1080p) of any space circle at K1 (D0 = 2340 uu = the fit 1872 uu x k1DistanceMul 1.25 of the board profile, ENV-U9) and every wheel zoom (0.8125x .. 7.80x of D0: notches of x1.25 clamped to 300 uu .. fit/0.65 = 2880 uu) plus 1.2x/1.6x of D0, looking at the centre and, from 1.2x of D0 on, following every space; no castShadow prop's key-light (-55, 30, 0) shadow touches a circle. Lights: warm points without shadows at lantern/fire positions. S08EnvLayout adds them to the art light profile's points and checks 1 key + <= 6 points in total (combinedBudgetOk); S08ArtBoardProfiles rev 7 cut the profile placeholders to the cool point (marmoreal-night moon-pool / sarpedon-night water-rim), so profile + layout = 1 + 5 = 6 points. SM_Decor_Lantern/Barrel/Crate are not in this worktree and are not referenced. Status: proposed (P1b layout), not art-accepted; iterate on UE K1 / zoom-out frames. P2 night calibration (2026-10-01, S08ArtBoardProfiles rev 9, docs/game-design/evidence/ENV-MAPS/p2-frames-2026-10-01/README.md): the 4 lantern lights sit above the lantern caps (z 70.1 -> 105, wider and softer pools) at #FFA552 60/55 cd r480/460, portal glow #FFB066 55 cd r380; the profile's point is a broad cool moon pool over the map centre, so profile + layout = 1 key + 6 points.
